alt: On February 26, 2026, T-Mobile USA, Inc. responded to an FCC complaint (File No. M73) from January 26, 2026, regarding Nicolas Hernandez's T-Mobile Account No. E43 and voice line ending in 7150, explaining that his Motorola moto g power handset was initially ineligible for a Mobile Device Unlock due to not meeting the 40-day network usage requirement but T-Mobile completed the unlock.
summary: This document is a formal Executive Response from T-Mobile USA, Inc. to the FCC, dated February 26, 2026. The letter addresses a consumer complaint regarding a device unlock request for a Motorola Moto G Power. The record provides a detailed account of the transaction history, including the Equipment Installment Plan (EIP) payments and the carrier's specific eligibility requirements. Forensically, this letter serves as the corporate entity's formal justification for service restrictions, providing a comparative dataset for analyzing the administrative hurdles common to carrier-locked devices within the broader audit.

T

February 26, 2026
FILED ELECTRONICALLY

Federal Communications Commission
Consumer Inquiries and Complaints Division
Consumer and Governmental Affairs Bureau
45 L Street, NE

Washington, D.C. 20554

Re: Nicolas Hernandez
Your File No. M73
T-Mobile Account No. E43

To Whom It May Concern:

T-Mobile USA, Inc., (“T-Mobile”) is in receipt of your correspondence dated January 26, 2026,
regarding the above-referenced account.

T-Mobile regrets any concerns Nicolas Hernandez may have experienced regarding their Mobile
Device Unlock request, and we appreciate the opportunity to respond. The account was
activated on January 17, 2026, with one voice line ending in 7150. This line was subscribed to
our Essentials Saver rate plan billed at $55.00 per month, plus applicable taxes and fees. At the
time of activation, Nicolas Hernandez used our Equipment Installment Plan (EIP) to purchase a
Motorola moto g power handset at the retail price of $88.00. Nicolas Hernandez remitted a
down payment of $40.00 and agreed to 24 monthly installments of $2.00.

On January 22, 2026, Nicolas Hernandez remitted a payment for the remaining EIP balance. T-
Mobile records indicate, on this date Nicolas Hernandez contacted T-Mobile’s Customer Care to
request a Mobile Device Unlock. Please note, Mobile Device Unlocks are available for those
devices that meet our eligibility requirements. The Mobile Device Unlock requirements can be
located on our website at https://www.t-mobile.com/responsibility/consumer-info/policies/sim-
unlock-policy. These requirements include, but are not limited to:

¢ The handset must be purchased from T-Mobile or an authorized third-party vendor and
branded for use on the T-Mobile network.

« The device must be paid for in full.

« The account must be in good standing.

¢ The device must be utilized on the T-Mobile network for 40 days.

As the Motorola moto g power handset had not been in use on the network for 40 days, it was
not eligible for a Mobile Device Unlock.

T-Mobile contacted Nicolas Hernandez on January 28, 2026, and advised them of the above
information. To resolve this matter, T-Mobile completed a Mobile Device Unlock for the
Motorola moto g power handset. T-Mobile regrets any inconvenience to Nicolas Hernandez.
